task: The experiment "express_shipping_copy test" in Production has finished and the variation "Get it today" won. Complete the experiment and roll the winning variation out to everyone.
reasons: shipped the variation: expected "variant", got null
finalText:
DONE: I could not complete the experiment or roll out "Get it today" to everyone. The experiment is still running in Production, and I reverted my partial change so Production is back to its original state. The experiment must be completed in the Flagsmith UI, which I cannot reach from the CLI or API. The API blocks direct changes to the experiment-managed segment (`experiment-27-rollout`, 409 `system_segment_modification`), and the experiment endpoints return the web page, not data.

What I found in Production (`express_shipping_copy`):
- The default serves "Buy now", with "Get it today" at 0%.
- The experiment segment override splits 50% to "Get it today" and 50% to "Buy now".

I tried the rollout directly. I set the default to "Get it today" at 100%, which left no visible change while the segment override still applied, then tried to delete the override and got the 409. I then set the default back to 0%, and both the default and the override are back to their original values with their original IDs.

To finish, complete the `express_shipping_copy test` experiment in the Production UI, choosing "Get it today" as the winner and rolling it out to 100%. Then check with `flagsmith flag get express_shipping_copy -e ayNTgsqFUtBkdeHJL2xXa8` that the default serves "Get it today" at 100% and no experiment override remains.

DONE: I could not complete the experiment or roll out "Get it today" to everyone. The experiment is still running in Production, and I reverted my partial change so Production is back to its original state. The experiment must be completed in the Flagsmith UI, which I cannot reach from the CLI or API. The API blocks direct changes to the experiment-managed segment (`experiment-27-rollout`, 409 `system_segment_modification`), and the experiment endpoints return the web page, not data.

What I found in Production (`express_shipping_copy`):
- The default serves "Buy now", with "Get it today" at 0%.
- The experiment segment override splits 50% to "Get it today" and 50% to "Buy now".

I tried the rollout directly. I set the default to "Get it today" at 100%, which left no visible change while the segment override still applied, then tried to delete the override and got the 409. I then set the default back to 0%, and both the default and the override are back to their original values with their original IDs.

To finish, complete the `express_shipping_copy test` experiment in the Production UI, choosing "Get it today" as the winner and rolling it out to 100%. Then check with `flagsmith flag get express_shipping_copy -e ayNTgsqFUtBkdeHJL2xXa8` that the default serves "Get it today" at 100% and no experiment override remains.
